snippet.title: Bball Destiny: a whole basketball career in your pocket
snippet.description:
Start at 16. Make the calls. Play a whole basketball career on your phone, from high school to the Hall of Fame. Free on Google Play.

▶ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bballdestiny.app&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=play-trailer
▶ Play in your browser: https://bballdestiny.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=play-trailer

Bball Destiny is a basketball career simulator. Every season puts new decisions in your hands, and safe plays and gambles are marked. Build your player, hear your name on draft night, chase rings, then retire and see where your career lands.

• More than 400 written scenes, each with real choices and real risk
• A full career takes 10 to 20 minutes
• Every career ends on a card to send your friends. About 1 card in 15 comes out holo.
• A public Hall of Fame for the best careers ever played
• Free to play, no account needed
• The career plays offline. Only the Hall of Fame, sharing and the account need a connection.

Bball Destiny is an independent game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any league, team or player.

#basketball #BballDestiny #careermode
